null_description: Independently reshuffle each person's yes/no decisions among that same person's contacts in same wave, preserving outgoing yes-degree for each chooser; recompute received-popularity excluding focal encounter, then r among newly mutual encounters
cautions: Designed after observing primary Columbia result, so NOT independent confirmatory test.
Changes both which pairs are matched and the popularity proxy estimates; not directly same fixed covariate null as primary.
Null is structural and cannot exclude preferences for similarity or unobserved factors.
No new research cycle counted for robustness.
